blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — The Philippines will make a push for some of the world’s biggest technology companies to locate within the planned Pax Silica hub in New Clark City, where development work could begin as early as 2027. Among those on the government’s “wish list” are Apple, Nvidia, Taiwan Semiconductor Manufacturing Co., MediaTek, United Microelectronics Corp., […]...
